controller_failure_alarm_high_bits_codes.b6: power supply status (0 battery power supply, 1 mains power supply)
controller_failure_alarm_high_bits_codes.b8: battery high temperature protection (temperature higher than the upper discharge limit) prohibit discharging
controller_failure_alarm_high_bits_codes.b9: battery low temperature protection (the temperature is lower than the lower discharge limit) prohibit discharging
controller_failure_alarm_high_bits_codes.b11: battery low temperature protection (temperature is lower than the lower limit of charging) stop charging

controller_failure_alarm_low_bits_codes.b6: battery high temperature protection (temperature higher than the upper discharge limit) prohibit charging

load_working_modes_codes.0: Sole light control, light control over on/off of load
load_working_modes_codes.1: Load is turned on by light control, and goes off after a time delay of 1 hour
